title: Close Posting Lineage
description: A month-end close lineage verdict over declared entries: GL coding entries and accrual entries in (lineage key, GL account, amount, optional source document digest, optional traces_to references), linkage structure out (accruals that resolve to a declared coding entry, accruals with no reference, every reference naming a key nothing declares, coding entries nothing traces to, coding entries with no source digest, repeated lineage keys, overall CLOSE_READY, GAPS_FOUND or INDETERMINATE). Four stages in one pure compute() per CLOSE-COMMAND-CENTER-BUILD-SPEC-2026-09-23.md section D2: intake with fail-closed shape validation, lineage key uniqueness, per accrual linkage classification, coding side observations and verdict. Unlinked accruals, dangling references and duplicate keys gate; orphan coding and missing source digests are advisory. The scope is the structure of declared linkage, never amount agreement. The spec's worked example is carried as the oracle-backed golden fixture (execution_hash 46b2cee4111553128514447ded7e205fb45bbdedccd75579f04c7ebc360d63d1).

as_of.description: Optional as-of date, YYYY-MM-DD; validated as a date string by the kernel whenever present, and never used as a clock.

coding_entries.description: Declared GL coding entries. May be empty; each entry must carry a non-empty key, a non-empty gl_account and a finite amount.

key.description: Caller-declared lineage key, period-scoped by convention; a key declared twice across both lists is reported as a duplicate.

amount.description: Declared amount. Carried, never compared: this node does not verify amount agreement.

source_document_digest.description: Optional digest of the source document. Absent reads as no declared digest and is reported as an advisory observation, not as malformed.

accrual_entries.description: Declared accrual entries. An empty list makes the register INDETERMINATE: there is no population over which linkage could be asserted.

traces_to.description: Coding entry keys this accrual claims to trace to. Absent or null reads as no reference, not as malformed.

input_schema.x_schema_provenance: derived-from-golden-fixtures 2026-09-24 (policy_parameters across the 20 vectors: coding_entries and accrual_entries are always the two declared lists, as_of optional; the intentionally malformed intake vectors deviate by design and are the fail-closed path, not the shape this schema describes)

linked_accruals.description: Accrual keys whose every declared reference resolves to a declared coding entry, in input order. An accrual that partly resolves is not here.

unlinked_accruals.description: Accrual keys declaring no reference at all, in input order. Gates the verdict.

dangling_trace_refs.description: One entry per reference naming a key no coding entry declares, reported with the accrual that declared it. Gates the verdict.

orphan_coding.description: Coding entry keys no accrual traces to. Advisory: recorded, never gating.

missing_source_refs.description: Coding entry keys with no declared source_document_digest. Advisory: recorded, never gating.

duplicate_lineage_keys.description: Keys declared more than once across the coding and accrual entries together, once per colliding key in first-repeat order. Gates the verdict.

overall.description: CLOSE_READY iff unlinked_accruals, dangling_trace_refs and duplicate_lineage_keys are all empty over a non-empty accrual set; INDETERMINATE on an empty or malformed register; GAPS_FOUND otherwise.

errors.description: Present only on the indeterminate path, carrying the reason no linkage assertion was possible; non-empty exactly when the conditional compliance flag CLOSE_LINEAGE_INDETERMINATE is present (flag-mirror doctrine).

output_schema.x_schema_provenance: derived-from-golden-fixtures 2026-09-24 (re-derived over all 20 golden fixture output_payloads, incl. the spec-oracle worked example; errors observed on the 12 indeterminate vectors only, absent on the 8 assertable vectors)
